versions.changelog:
acestep-simplemv 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling music video rendering from audio and lyrics using Remotion.
- Generates MP4 videos with waveform visualization and synced lyrics display.
- Supports LRC or JSON lyrics formats and customizable title, subtitle, and credit text.
- Includes robust browser auto-detection and headless rendering mode management for Remotion.
- Includes detailed setup, usage instructions, and file naming guidelines to avoid overwrites.
